units.source_text: 这个时候，女佣也回来了，并递给俊吉几张明信片。

en.t: Just then, the maid also came back and handed Shunkichi several postcards.

units.source_text: 俊吉马上坐到书桌前，刷刷的开始了写作。

en.t: Shunkichi immediately sat down at the desk and began writing briskly.

units.source_text: 发现女佣之前并不在家，照子好像有些意外，说道：“所以，姐姐来家里的时候，没人在家吗？”

en.t: When Teruko realized that the maid had not been home earlier, she seemed a little surprised and said, "So when my sister came to the house, no one was home?"

units.source_text: 这个时候，俊吉扭过头来对照子说：“茶也是我替你沏的，你要感激你的丈夫。”

en.t: At that moment, Shunkichi turned his head toward Teruko and said, "I made the tea for you too, so you should be grateful to your husband."

units.source_text: 照子恶作剧般对着姐姐笑了起来，却故意没搭理丈夫。

en.t: Teruko gave her sister a mischievous smile, but deliberately ignored her husband.
